title: Colours | Nursery General Knowledge for Kids | Little Takhti
description:
Learn the colours red, yellow, green, blue, orange and purple with Takhti. Sort things by colour, make a rainbow and try a quick colour quiz. For Nursery children (ages 3 to 4).

Free printable worksheets, quizzes and games for this topic: https://littletakhti.netlify.app/nursery-general-knowledge-colours-worksheets/

0:00 Colours around us
0:35 Colour sort
0:54 Rainbow
1:06 Quiz
1:48 Remember

Little Takhti makes free learning for children in Pakistan, Nursery to Grade 3. https://littletakhti.netlify.app
